messages:
Maya Li: Quick sync — proposal to launch a Metered Entitlements model for trials + Starter tier. Goal: predictable unit economics for self-serve while keeping signup friction low. cc @Chris O'Connor @Anita Patel :eyes:
Chris O'Connor: high level — is this tokens or calls? need cost calc per unit before we design UI/limits
Maya Li: tokens as primary billing unit (aligns with existing hosted API). but also need a simple request cap for edge cases.
Anita Patel: customers asking for smoother trial -> they want a soft throttle rather than hard cutoffs. propose: soft-limit (throttle at 90%), 7-day overage grace for first-time overruns.
Tom Nguyen: engineering note — soft-limit + grace requires: realtime quota check (fast path), webhook/event on throttle, and a reconciliation job for billing. storage/migration for existing customers who have unlimited trials will be the hairy bit. estimate spike + API spec = 2w, implementation = 3w, rollout + telemetry = 1w.
Maya Li: suggested launch criteria (minimal): docs + console UI for quota, API for entitlement queries, billing events in house analytics, rollout plan, and e2e test harness.
Chris O'Connor: also need sample pricing mapping: Starter -> 5M tokens/mo; Growth -> 50M tokens/mo; Add-on for extra tokens. we'll finalize numbers but need a schema we can easily expand.
Anita Patel: Sales ops ask — make Starter opt-out for enterprise deals. For SMB self-serve, Starter is default. For enterprise, we need explicit opt-in/opt-out flags.
Tom Nguyen: technical sample config (for discussion):
```json
{
  "tier": "starter",
  "monthly_token_budget": 5000000,
  "soft_limit_pct": 90,
  "overage_grace_days": 7,
  "overage_action": "throttle_then_block"
}
```
Maya Li: nice. owners: Tom for API & runtime changes, Chris for pricing mapping and telemetry metrics, Anita for GTM/sales gating, LegalBot/SalesBot handle contract language.
SalesBot: legal heads-up — we need explicit language for "first overage forgiveness" and for cases where we throttle vs bill. Legal wants template text before pilot.
LegalBot: noted. we'll draft a short clause: "First billing period overages up to X% will be credited at provider discretion; recurrent overages are billable." will share soon.
Chris O'Connor: rollout phases proposal: 1) internal pilot (selected accounts), 2) open self-serve with messaging and console indicators, 3) gated enterprise opt-out. metrics to watch: conversion, incidence of overage, support tickets, and unit cost delta.
Maya Li: acceptance criteria before GA: < 1% failed requests due to quota bugs in pilot, console shows live quota for 95% of sessions, billing events appear within 5m in analytics, and legal clause + docs published.
Tom Nguyen: I'll open the API spec PR tomorrow: /prs/infra/entitlements/123 (placeholder). planning spike this week to validate perf.
Anita Patel: GTM checklist: email templates, onboarding flows mention soft throttle, support playbook, pricing page copy. I'll own that. :thumbsup:
Maya Li: thanks — next steps: Tom spike by EOW, Chris draft pricing schema by Wed, Legal draft clause by Thu, Anita draft GTM assets. sync Friday 10am to lock launch week.
Chris O'Connor: noted. I'll also add an event stream sample for analytics to the PR.
Tom Nguyen: cool. ping me in #eng-runtime if you want the quota emulator for testing.
Maya Li: thanks team — keeping this tight. any objections to timeline?
Anita Patel: none from me.
SalesBot: adding a task for contract review with Legal.
Maya Li: end.
